meta.title: Prompt Fusion
meta.description: Meaning-preserving offline prompt guidance, review and apply, voice transcription, and portable agent adapters.

ui.title: Prompt Fusion
ui.contextHint: Paste only reference data needed for this request (8 KiB budget), excluding credentials. No files or past sessions are scanned.
ui.memoryHint: Memory is off by default, retains one draft in this component, and clears on send, empty draft, session switch or unload. Model-assisted mode sends the prompt and explicitly selected data to the current model; provider charges may apply.
ui.dictionary: Term dictionary (JSON object, max 24 pairs; cleanup suggestions only)
ui.dictionaryInvalid: Dictionary must be a valid JSON object.
ui.hotkeyHint: When enabled: Alt+Shift+P previews; Alt+Shift+V starts/stops recording. Disable on shortcut conflicts. Maximum 120 seconds, or 12 seconds with no speech.
ui.privacy: Offline by default. Review, apply to the draft, then send yourself.
ui.speechSetup: Configure speech recognition in DSH settings.
ui.recording: Recording. Stop or cancel when ready.
ui.stale: Draft changed. Preview or record again; existing edits were retained.
ui.caretEnd: Place the composer caret at the end of the original text, then confirm. Native references and attachments are preserved.
ui.unchanged: Original retained; there is no guidance to append.
ui.applied: Guidance added to the draft; not sent.
ui.transcriptReview: Review the transcript before inserting it.
ui.transcriptInserted: Transcript inserted. You can now preview enhancement.
ui.previewHint: The original is retained verbatim. Appended guidance is subordinate to it. Review before applying; this plugin never executes the prompt's task.
ui.copyManual: Select and copy text from the preview box.
ui.hostUnsupported: Composer API is not ready. Use a compatible DSH version and retry.
